classification.reason: This is a direct refund request, which per policy is only ever executed by a human manager, never an agent.

draft.reply:
Hi,

Thanks for reaching out, and sorry to hear the Team plan wasn't the right fit.

Under our refund policy, requests made within 14 calendar days of the charge date are eligible for a full refund. Since you upgraded 5 days ago, your request falls within that window.

I'm not able to process refunds directly — that has to be reviewed and completed by one of our support managers through the billing system. I've flagged your request for their review, and they'll follow up with you on the outcome.

Thanks for your patience in the meantime.

Best,
Loopwise Support
citations: refund_policy.md item 1: 'Full refunds are available if requested within 14 calendar days of the charge date, for any reason.' — supports eligibility statement based on the 5-day-old charge.

refund_policy.md item 6: 'A support agent (human or automated) may confirm the policy and check the charge date, but must never promise a refund amount or approve a refund outright. Refunds are only executed by a manager through the billing system.' — supports framing the refund as pending manager review/execution rather than approved or guaranteed.

verification.notes: Both citations are accurate and directly support the reply's claims; the reply correctly states 14-day eligibility without approving or promising the refund, deferring execution to a manager as policy requires, and maintains a professional tone.
